simple_explanation: 'Water — The Essence of Life' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Students in Grades 3 and 4 have explored soil, air and water.
They also learned how life evolves in different landforms depending upon the availability of soil, air, water and sunlight.
This unit in Grade 5 presents the importance of water in life and ecosystems.
It also covers its various forms, movement, and role in shaping land and supporting habitats.
The unit conveys water as a unique and limited essence of life — showing how it helps in sustaining the life on Earth.
